product_one_liner.value: Forwood Safety provides critical-risk management software and verification tools that help organisations in high-risk industries prevent workplace fatalities and serious injuries.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plans page was found; the pricing URL did not return a readable page.

eng_blog.notes: The news index is predominantly safety, customer and product content; fewer than two qualifying engineering-authored how-built posts were identified.

public_docs.notes: Public help center includes CCV app setup and Team Management content.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page accepts applications; indexed openings cover sales, service desk and critical-risk expertise, with no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title found. The embedded board did not render as a complete list.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services — Amazon QuickSight Q
model_provider.notes: Forwood explicitly identifies QuickSight Q for natural-language, machine-learning-powered analytics; this does not identify the underlying models used in its other AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001 and GDPR alignment language in the privacy policy was not treated as certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook dates the latest recorded deal to 31 October 2023; its public table does not disclose the amount. Macquarie confirms investment but describes the investment process as beginning in 2022. USD amount remains unknown.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is October 2023, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window. A database claiming the company is unfunded conflicts with the investor’s own account and was not relied on.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Account Executive – Enterprise SaaS Sales, Rome, Italy.

launched_6mo.notes: Newest explicit launch found: Safety+ 2.0 and its mobile app, 2025-01-21. The June 2026 Forwood One item describes an early preview, not a launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The four-person executive page names the current leaders but gives no start dates; no dated qualifying appointment or departure could be verified for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The setup article identifies Intercom Messenger for support. No named sales CRM was verified; Forwood CRM+ means Critical Risk Management, not customer relationship management.
